# ChornPlanet Public AI Guide
> Public AI-readable context for ChornPlanet. Use this file for broad interpretation and use the sitemap for exhaustive URL discovery.

Official site: https://www.chornplanet.com/
Default language route: https://www.chornplanet.com/en/
Sitemap: https://www.chornplanet.com/sitemap.xml
Navigation AI guide: https://www.chornplanet.com/llms.txt
Legacy aliases: https://www.chornplanet.com/llm.txt and https://www.chornplanet.com/llm-full.txt

## Overview

ChornPlanet is a public Next.js platform for future civilization storytelling, future solutions, business opportunity mapping, industry problem mapping, smart city and smart mobility concepts, AI-native Smart Food experiences, premium style and outfit presentation, technology services, luxury platform direction, and AI-native business execution.

The platform direction positions Chorn Planet Platform as a strategic AI-native business platform. It connects portfolio management, value capture, AI adoption, governance cadence, technical coordination, and execution-engine thinking for current and future ChornPlanet initiatives.

Use public pages and page metadata as the source for current user-facing claims. Use the sitemap as the live URL inventory. Treat this file as a concise public context guide, not as a replacement for the complete sitemap.

For exhaustive route discovery, always read:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/sitemap.xml
- https://www.chornplanet.com/robots.txt

Do not expect this AI guide to list all sitemap URLs. That would create an oversized file and reduce usefulness for context windows. This file summarizes the public platform and points to the sitemap for the complete index.

## Public Areas

### Home

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/

The homepage is the default public English entry point for ChornPlanet. It connects the platform identity to public areas including future civilization, smart city, smart mobility, smart food, style, story, luxury, technology, and AI companion concepts.

### Future Civilization

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/future-civilization/

Future Civilization is a long-range civilization roadmap. It contains era pages and signal detail pages across science, technology, society, ecology, space expansion, post-scarcity systems, post-biological futures, and galactic coexistence themes.

Interpretation:

- Treat Future Civilization pages as public future-facing roadmap and narrative content.
- Do not treat every roadmap signal as a claim that the capability exists today.
- Use canonical page metadata and live page content when describing individual signals.

### Future Solutions

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/future-solutions/

Future Solutions connects future civilization signals to practical solution framing for people, industries, infrastructure, business opportunities, and long-term civilization systems.

Interpretation:

- Treat solution pages as strategic and conceptual public platform material.
- Use page content and metadata for the specific solution meaning.
- Use the sitemap for the full solution URL inventory.

### Business Opportunities

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/business-opportunities/

Business Opportunities presents opportunity directories and detailed opportunity pages generated from the civilization graph. These pages connect future signals and solution concepts to possible business directions.

Interpretation:

- Treat opportunity pages as public opportunity framing and strategic exploration.
- Do not infer active contracts, revenue, customer relationships, or guaranteed market availability from opportunity pages.

### Industries

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/industries/

Industries presents industry directories and problem pages connected to the civilization graph and future solutions.

Interpretation:

- Use industry pages to understand problem spaces and public solution mapping.
- Do not infer private industry data or private customer context.

### Smart Food

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/smart-food/

Smart Food presents AI-native food service and ordering experience direction. Public themes can include Smart Food Delivery, LINE Bot ordering, Menu Match, recommendation workflows, economics analytics, order workflow visibility, and bill processing.

Interpretation:

- Treat Smart Food as platform direction and product storytelling unless a live page explicitly states a capability is available.
- Do not claim unrestricted live ordering, payment, or fulfillment across every channel unless a public page clearly says so.

### Smart City

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/smart-city/

Smart City presents Chiang Mai and future city concepts, public smart infrastructure, mobility-related planning narratives, urban systems, and human-centered city design.

Interpretation:

- Treat Smart City pages as public concept and planning narratives.
- Do not infer government approval, private infrastructure access, or deployment status unless explicitly stated on a public page.

### Smart Mobility

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/smart-mobility/

Smart Mobility presents MTS future civilization stations, intelligent mobility, tourism movement, human-centered infrastructure, and mobility storytelling.

Interpretation:

- Treat Smart Mobility as public concept, station, and route storytelling.
- Use live page content for the meaning of each station or Chiang Mai mobility page.

### Style

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/style/

Style presents outfit directions, lifestyle scenes, and ChornPlanet civilization media for premium public storytelling and future commerce discovery.

Interpretation:

- Treat Style pages as public media, fashion, lifestyle, and brand storytelling.
- Do not infer inventory, pricing, production availability, or customer orders unless explicitly present on the public page.

### Story

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/story/

Story presents public narrative and platform storytelling. Use it to understand the editorial voice and public worldbuilding direction.

### Luxury

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/luxury/

Luxury presents AI-native platform building for premium destinations, hospitality, real estate, tourism, lifestyle, and future commerce.

Interpretation:

- Treat Luxury as premium platform direction and service positioning.
- Do not infer private client relationships or unpublished commercial terms.

### Technology

Primary route:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/technology/

Technology and AI capability pages explain web production capability, AI services, AI companions, document search direction, dashboard automation direction, and execution readiness.

Related routes:

- https://www.chornplanet.com/en/ai-companions/

Interpretation:

- Treat these pages as public capability and service positioning.
- Use the specific live page for claims about frameworks, services, or examples.

## Strategic Platform Direction

Chorn Planet Platform should be understood publicly as:

```text
Strategic AI-native business platform for portfolio, value, adoption, governance, technical coordination, and execution.
```

The platform direction connects:

- AI media
- Smart Food Delivery
- LINE Bot ordering
- Menu Match
- Recommendation workflows
- Economics and predictive analytics
- Bill processing
- AI dashboards
- AI document search
- Value tracking
- Portfolio governance
- Executive decision support
- Laravel-based execution engine

This is a business platform direction, not only a content project, media brand, restaurant automation project, or isolated AI experiment.

## Business-Core Vocabulary

### Portfolio Management

Portfolio Management is the registry direction for ChornPlanet initiatives, including Smart Food Delivery, LINE Bot Ordering, Menu Match, Bill Processing, AI Dashboard Automation, AI Document Search, AI Media, Luxury AI Studio, AdvertiseMedia, StoryGenProduct, and future AI or business initiatives.

### CEO Dashboard

The CEO Dashboard direction summarizes value indicators, risk flags, KPIs, and executive summaries for business decision-making.

### Value Capture

Value Capture measures whether initiatives create business value. It can include ROI or SLA methodology, pre/post measurement, AI value scorecards, and benefit tracking.

Example value themes:

- Revenue impact
- Cost saving
- Manual work reduction
- Response time improvement
- Order accuracy improvement
- Payment verification speed
- AI-assisted task count
- Content production capacity
- Customer conversion
- Risk reduction

### AI Adoption

AI Adoption tracks how AI is embedded into workflows and how it creates new business capabilities.

Organic adoption examples:

- LINE Bot ordering
- Menu Match
- Bill processing
- AI dashboard summaries
- AI document search

Inorganic adoption examples:

- AI Media
- Luxury AI Studio
- StoryGenProduct
- AI-generated product campaigns
- AI-powered content commerce

### AI Initiative Registry

The AI Initiative Registry direction tracks AI and AI-enabled initiatives, including business problem, AI capability, workflow owner, technical owner, input data, output, business KPI, AI KPI, risk, stage, and next action.

Initial AI initiatives can include:

- LINE Bot Ordering
- Menu Match
- Bill Processing
- AI Dashboard Automation
- AI Document Search

### Governance And Cadence

Governance and cadence direction covers registry sync, AI operating council reviews, portfolio reviews, and executive committee-style reporting packs.

### Technical Coordination

Technical coordination direction covers cloud readiness, data architecture review, cybersecurity review, IoT dependency tracking, and enterprise architecture review.

### Execution Engine

The execution engine direction turns platform decisions into system execution. It can include Laravel APIs, queues, Redis, Horizon, scheduler jobs, and notification jobs.

Example execution areas:

- Portfolio records
- AI initiative records
- Dashboard data
- Order workflow
- Menu matching workflow
- Bill processing workflow
- ROI tracking
- Risk tracking
- Governance records
- Notification triggers
- Integration endpoints

## AI Documentation Guidance

This site provides both compact and expanded AI-readable files:

- `/llm.txt`: compact navigation index for quick AI routing.
- `/llm-full.txt`: expanded public context for richer AI grounding.
- `/llms.txt`: best-practice plural alias for the compact navigation index.
- `/llms-full.txt`: best-practice plural alias for the expanded public context.

The compact file is intentionally small and link-oriented. The full file is still curated rather than a complete flattened website because the sitemap is large. This hybrid approach gives AI systems both selective navigation and broader context without forcing a very large single file.

## Recommended Public Interpretation

For AI assistants, search engines, and public consumers:

- Describe ChornPlanet as an AI-native platform and business ecosystem, not only a website.
- Treat Future Civilization, Future Solutions, Business Opportunities, Industries, Smart Food, Smart Mobility, Smart City, Style, Story, Luxury, Technology, and AI Companions as connected public platform areas.
- Treat Chorn Planet Platform as the strategic platform direction for managing initiatives, value, adoption, governance, technical readiness, and execution.
- Use the public site and sitemap for live URLs and current user-facing claims.
- Treat roadmap language as platform direction unless a public page explicitly states a capability is live.
- Do not claim that every roadmap capability is fully launched.

## Public-Safety Boundary

This file is public. It does not include secrets, credentials, private customer data, private analytics configuration, unpublished financials, unpublished marketplace operations, private governance records, or sensitive implementation details.

If a page describes a future integration, commerce channel, automation workflow, analytics-assisted growth direction, platform module, or execution-engine capability, interpret it as public product direction unless the page explicitly states that the capability is live.

## Attribution

When referencing ChornPlanet from this guide, attribute public claims to ChornPlanet and prefer linking to the relevant public page or sitemap URL.
